source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: In an Imperialis Fleet army, a **CHARACTER** attached to a unit chosen for the [Clandestine Operation](vsdata:ability/imperial-agents.imperialis-fleet.clandestine-operation) or [Combat Landers](vsdata:ability/imperial-agents.imperialis-fleet.combat-landers) Enhancement gains that Enhancement’s ability too: **[Infiltrators](vsdata:core-ability/infiltrators)** from Clandestine Operation, **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)** from Combat Landers.
